name: drop-table-section
relation: approving the drop rests on the migration's status section
locus: the migration tracker and the change request the database reviewer reads
purpose: drop a table only when no data and no reader is lost
trajectory: the migration tracker, the change request, the review, the production database
crossing: the approval on the change request
promise: the reviewer approves because the section shows the data copied, the writes stopped and the reads gone; without the section they keep the table or say unclear
baseline: the tracker and the request as they stand; nothing changed

spans.text: Migration status: the backfill copied every orders_v1 row into orders_v2, and the row counts match.
Migration status: writes to orders_v1 stopped on 1 October.
Migration status: the query log shows no reads of orders_v1 in the last 30 days.
Migration status: invoices_v2 went live in August.
Migration status: the customers index rebuild is set for November.
Migration status: the old reporting replica was retired in July.
Migration status: sessions moved to Redis in June.
Migration status: the audit log table is now partitioned by month.
Migration status: the search cluster was upgraded in September.

observe.instruction: You review database change requests. Use only the evidence given. Answer drop if the table can be dropped now without losing data or breaking a reader, keep if it cannot, unclear if the evidence does not decide.
